cache.disk.directory.description: Filesystem path where tile cache is stored on disk.

cache.disk.cleanup.enabled.description: Enable background cleanup of expired tiles.

cache.db.type.description: Database backend for tile storage (optional: use for distributed setups).

cache.db.sqlite.path.description: Path to SQLite database file (if using SQLite cache).

cache.db.postgres.host.description: PostgreSQL server host (if using PostgreSQL cache).

cache.db.postgres.password.description: PostgreSQL password (leave empty for peer auth or external credential).

cache.db.postgres.table.description: PostgreSQL table name for tile storage.

name.description: Unique tileset name (used as layer identifier in WMS/WMTS).

source.name.description: Name of the source (defined in <sources>) used by this tileset.

meta_tiles.description: Enable meta-tiling to reduce edge-artifacts (reduces tile count by factor of n²).

grid.description: Tile grid profile — e.g., 'global-mercator', 'global-geodetic', or custom grid name.

metadata.description: Optional tileset metadata (e.g., title, abstract, keywords).

expires.description: Tile cache expiry time in seconds (per tileset).

acl.allow.description: List of allowed IP subnets/CIDRs (leave empty for unrestricted access).

tilesets.description: List of tilesets (layers) to cache, each referencing a source and defining cache behavior.

name.description: Source identifier — must match the source.name in tilesets.

wms.headers.description: Optional HTTP headers for WMS requests (e.g., 'Authorization', 'User-Agent').

timeout.description: Request timeout in seconds for upstream fetches.

retries.description: Number of retries for failed upstream requests.

sources.description: Upstream data sources used by tilesets.

services.kml.enabled.description: Enable KML (Keyhole Markup Language) endpoint for Google Earth.

services.wmts.enabled.description: Enable WMTS (Web Map Tile Service) endpoint.

errors.report.description: Whether to return detailed error messages in responses (set to 'false' for security in production).

defaults.expires.description: Global default tile cache expiry (seconds), used if tileset doesn't specify.

defaults.tile_cache.description: Name of the default tile cache to use if not set per tileset.
